name: BCR activator of RhoGEF and GTPase

function.text: BCR encodes breakpoint cluster region protein. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine kinase activity and protein serine/threonine kinase activity. It participates in signal transduction and small GTPase-mediated signal transduction.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Acute myeloid leukemia; Chronic myeloid leukemia; B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
